uat_artifacts: Live end-to-end production UAT PASSED 2026-07-17 on Worker version 3347a2c7 (workspace.internjobs.ai). Operator sent a prompt-injection email from a personal (non-member, non-trusted, non-skip-listed) address to a real internjobs.ai employee mailbox: it landed in the SPAM folder (quarantined + persisted, NOT silently dropped), was visible and openable, and 'Trust sender' moved it back to the Inbox.

Boot-check: /api/health returned 200 x3 with real JSON and no workerd 1101/1102 boot-error signature (the entrypoint non-function-export trap did not fire); /api/inbox/messages?folder=spam returns 401 (routed, auth-gated) not 500; wrangler.jsonc cron unchanged (single */5).

Migration 10 (trusted_senders) self-application confirmed live: the operator signed in and the email pane rendered normally — applyMigrations() runs in the EmployeeMailboxDO constructor, so a faulty migration would have errored the mailbox instead.
Full report: .planning/milestones/v1.5/phases/36-lakera-failopen-quarantine/36-VERIFICATION.md (status: passed, 8/8 automated must-haves verified against source + production UAT).
risks: NO REVOKE UI for trusted senders. 'Trust sender' is a durable per-employee grant — the sender permanently bypasses Lakera screening for that mailbox — and nothing in the product lists or revokes it. A confirm dialog was added (558dfd6) to guard the misclick, but a trusted-senders review/revoke surface is an accepted FOLLOW-UP, not shipped here. (Decision: Nithin, 2026-07-17.)

30-day purge uses the email's own `date` header, not a quarantined-at timestamp. Since senders control that header, backdated spam is purge-eligible on its first sweep. Inherited from 36-01 as shipped; flagged, not fixed.
Auto-purge turns the pre-existing R2 attachment-orphan gap (shared with Trash hard-delete) from occasional into recurring. Pre-existing behaviour, not introduced here.

Tests mock the Durable Object, so the storage layer is covered by production UAT rather than by the suite. Mitigated: 36-04's assertions were mutation-verified (reverting the quarantine to the old `return` drop turns 3 tests red; inverting the trust check turns 1 red; breaking fail-open turns 1 red).

Track 2 partially open by design: LAKERA-V2-03 (Lakera tier/quota confirmation) is dashboard-only and account-gated to Raj — recorded as a pending hand-off in infra/LAKERA-PRICING.md, deliberately NOT fabricated.

Accepted CI gap (Decision: Nithin, 2026-07-16): apps/app/src/safety/screen.test.mjs passes (5/5) but is not wired into CI — the `workspaces` job only runs build:app. The shared CI workflow was intentionally left untouched; the Worker-side fail-open tests added in 36-04 DO run via the parrot job's `npm test` and are accepted as the closing evidence for SAFETY-VERIFY-LIVE-03.
